title: metadata of datasets
description: The metadata of datasets is used by several domains.

id.title: Decentral identifier
id.description: Together with timestamp uniquely identifies data and version.

timestamp.title: Timestamp that designates the version
timestamp.description: Together with decentral identifier uniquely identifies data and version. For example, correction of some grammatical error in the description results in a new version designated by a new timestamp, or adding an approval by some stakeholder.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Critical information to avoid mistakes due to data misinterpretation.

createdAt.title: Creation timestamp
createdAt.description: When the present dataset was created, for example, after completion of a measurement, simulation, or calculation.

appliedMethod.description: Method that was applied to create this dataset.

approvals.description: Approvals by stakeholders in the form of GnuPG signatures.
